2.  Data importing and merging

```{r}

#Loading the data into r

#Census
census  <- read.csv(file.choose(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) #Select census with values dataset

census <- census %>% rename(zone_code = data_zone_code)


#Old LGD 1992 lookup table

zone_to_lgd_path <- file.choose() #Select "2021 data zone to old lgd and urban rural classification"

zone_to_lgd <- read_excel(path = zone_to_lgd_path, sheet = 4)

zone_to_lgd <- zone_to_lgd %>%
  select(DZ2021_code, LGD1992_code, LGD1992_name) %>%
  rename(zone_code = DZ2021_code, lgd = LGD1992_code, lgd_name = LGD1992_name)

#Urban/rural classification dataset 

Urban_class <- read_excel(path = zone_to_lgd_path, sheet = 5)

Urban_class <- Urban_class %>%
  select(DZ2021_code, Urban_status) %>%
  rename(zone_code = DZ2021_code) %>%
  mutate(Urban_status = ifelse(tolower(Urban_status) == "urban", 1L, 0L))


#Aft model info for later (block 7)

aft_model_path <- file.choose() #Choose aft_model_info

#NI shapefile for later (block 10)

NI_shapefile_path <- file.choose() #Choose DZ2021.shp


#Merging LGD and urban classification datasets into census data

census_merged <- census %>% 
  left_join(zone_to_lgd, by = "zone_code") %>%
  left_join(Urban_class, by = "zone_code")

#NI lifetables for QALYs

NI_lifetable_path <- file.choose()

```

3.  Creating the lambda value for each zone

```{r}
#3.a - creating count * prob of arrest
census_merged <- census_merged %>% mutate(count * p)

#3.b - Grouping by zone and summing

zone_values <- census_merged %>% 
  group_by(zone_code, data_zone, lgd, lgd_name, Urban_status) %>%
  summarise(
     count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    lambda = sum(`count * p`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")
```

4.  Generating cardiac arrests using 1000 poisson sims for each data zone

```{r}

# 4.a - Example for a single data zone
lambda_example <- zone_values$lambda[1]

sim_example <- rpois(1000, lambda_example)

head(sim_example)

# 4.b - Grouping by zone and simulating

poisson_sims <- zone_values %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(n_arrests = list(rpois(1000, lambda)))

#4.c - expand into long form

poisson_sims <- poisson_sims %>%
  unnest(n_arrests) %>%
  group_by(zone_code) %>%
  mutate(sim = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

poisson_sims <- poisson_sims %>%
  mutate(n_arrests = as.integer(n_arrests)) #Making sure number of arrests is an integer value so below chunk works


```

Assigning age/sex to each ca:

```{r}

# 1. Age-sex probabilities within each zone
age_sex_probs <- census_merged %>%
  transmute(zone_code, age_band, gender, prob = count * p) %>%
  group_by(zone_code) %>%
  mutate(prob = prob / sum(prob, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2. Expand to one row per arrest
arrests_long <- poisson_sims %>%
  uncount(n_arrests, .id = "arrest_id") %>%
  group_by(zone_code) %>%
  mutate(zone_row = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()



# 3. Number of arrests in each zone
zone_counts <- arrests_long %>%
  count(zone_code, name = "n")

# 4. Sample age/gender for all arrests in each zone at once
age_sex_split <- split(age_sex_probs, age_sex_probs$zone_code)

sampled_demo <- map2_dfr(
  zone_counts$zone_code,
  zone_counts$n,
  \(z, n) {
    tab <- age_sex_split[[as.character(z)]]
    draws <- sample(seq_len(nrow(tab)), size = n, replace = TRUE, prob = tab$prob)

    tibble(
      zone_code = z,
      zone_row = seq_len(n),
      age_band = tab$age_band[draws],
      gender = tab$gender[draws]
    )
  }
)

# 5. Join back to arrest rows
arrests_long <- arrests_long %>%
  left_join(sampled_demo, by = c("zone_code", "zone_row")) %>%
  select(-zone_row)


```



5.  Assign each event an hour in which it occurs

```{r}
#Example:

ncounts_example <- 10

hours <- sample(0:23, size = ncounts_example, replace = TRUE)

hours


#Function that converts the sampled hour to its corresponding hour block

hour_to_block <- function(h) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    h >= 0  & h <= 7  ~ "00-07",
    h >= 8  & h <= 9  ~ "08-09",
    h >= 10 & h <= 13 ~ "10-13",
    h >= 14 & h <= 23 ~ "14-23"
  )
}

hour_to_block(hours)

#Sampling the hour non-uniformly (0-23), row-wise to our simulated data (poisson_sims) 

block_probs <- c(
  "00_07" = 101 / 602,
  "08_09" = 100 / 602,
  "10_13" = 154 / 602,
  "14_23" = 247 / 602
)

hour_poisson_sims <- arrests_long %>%
  mutate(
    hour_block = sample(
      names(block_probs),
      size = n(),
      replace = TRUE,
      prob = block_probs
    )
  )


hour_poisson_sims <- hour_poisson_sims %>% #Unnesting: for each data zone, sims where n_arrests = 0 are skipped
  unnest(hour_block)


# 2) Make sure the factor has all levels (important if some hours missing)
hour_poisson_sims$hour_block <- factor(hour_poisson_sims$hour_block, levels = c("00_07", "08_09", "10_13", "14_23"))

# 3) Create binary columns (one-hot). This returns a matrix.
X <- model.matrix(~ hour_block - 1, data = hour_poisson_sims)
# columns: hour_block00_07, hour_block08_09, hour_block10_13, hour_block14_23

# 4) Bind back into hour_poisson_sims (as plain numeric columns)
hour_poisson_sims <- cbind(hour_poisson_sims, as.data.frame(X))

# Rename columns to your preferred names
names(hour_poisson_sims)[(ncol(hour_poisson_sims)-3):ncol(hour_poisson_sims)] <- c("hb_00_07", "hb_08_09", "hb_10_13", "hb_14_23")


```

7.  AFT

```{r}
params <- read_excel(aft_model_path, sheet = 1) %>%
  select(-matches("^Unnamed")) %>%
  transmute(
    lgd = lgd,
    intercept = intercept,
    b_ln_d1   = `ln(min_dist+1)`,
    b_ln_d2   = `ln(2nd_closest+1)`,
    b_lt2     = logic_less_Than_2,
    b_h0007   = hour0007,
    b_h0809   = hour0809,
    b_h1013   = hour1013,
    b_h1423   = hour1423,
    sigma     = scale
  )

# Join by 2-letter code column eg. Fermanagh = PP

df2 <- df %>%
  left_join(
    params %>% mutate(lgd = paste0("95", lgd)),
    by = "lgd"
  )


stopifnot(sum(is.na(df2$intercept)) == 0)

# Compute mu 
df2 <- df2 %>%
  mutate(
    mu = intercept +
      b_ln_d1 * ln_nearest1_miles +
      b_ln_d2 * ln_nearest2_miles +
      b_lt2   * near_2mi +
      b_h0007 * hb_00_07 +
      b_h0809 * hb_08_09 +
      b_h1013 * hb_10_13 +
      b_h1423 * hb_14_23
  )

# Log-logistic survival at threshold t0 = 7 (target)
t0 <- 7
df2 <- df2 %>%
  mutate(
    z = (log(t0) - mu) / sigma,
    p_le_t0 = plogis(z),
    s_gt_t0 = plogis(-z)
    
    
  )


df2 <- df2 %>%
  mutate(
    U = runif(n()),                 # U = F
    T_sim = exp(mu + sigma * qlogis(U))
  )

```

9. FR allocations
```{r}
zone_count <- zone_values %>%
  select("zone_code", "data_zone", "count", "lgd", "lgd_name")

total_vol_ni <- 806   # 31 x 26 LGDs

NI_shapefile <- st_read(NI_shapefile_path)

NI_shapefile <- NI_shapefile %>%
  rename("zone_code" = "DZ2021_cd")

# Base table
alloc_base <- zone_values %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(
    NI_shapefile %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(zone_code, Area_ha),
    by = "zone_code"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    area_km2 = Area_ha / 100,
    lambda_std = lambda / sum(lambda, na.rm = TRUE),
    area_std   = area_km2 / sum(area_km2, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Helper: NI-wide total allocation 
make_alloc_ni <- function(data, score_var, rule_name, total_vol_ni = 806) {
  out <- data %>%
    mutate(
      score = {{ score_var }},
      raw_target = total_vol_ni * score / sum(score, na.rm = TRUE),
      fr_target = floor(raw_target),
      remainder = raw_target - fr_target,
      rule = rule_name
    )

  n_left <- total_vol_ni - sum(out$fr_target, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (n_left > 0) {
    add_idx <- order(out$remainder, decreasing = TRUE)[1:n_left]
    out$fr_target[add_idx] <- out$fr_target[add_idx] + 1
  }

  out
}

# Helper: 31 within each LGD 
make_alloc_lgd <- function(data, score_var, rule_name, fr_per_lgd = 31) {
  data %>%
    group_by(lgd) %>%
    mutate(
      score = {{ score_var }},
      raw_target = fr_per_lgd * score / sum(score, na.rm = TRUE),
      fr_target = floor(raw_target),
      remainder = raw_target - fr_target
    ) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      d <- .x
      n_left <- fr_per_lgd - sum(d$fr_target, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (n_left > 0) {
        add_idx <- order(d$remainder, decreasing = TRUE)[1:n_left]
        d$fr_target[add_idx] <- d$fr_target[add_idx] + 1
      }
      d
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(rule = rule_name)
}

# NI-wide exploratory rules 
fr_alloc_lambda_across_NI <- make_alloc_ni(
  alloc_base,
  score_var = lambda,
  rule_name = "lambda_across_NI",
  total_vol_ni = total_vol_ni
)

fr_alloc_lambda_area10 <- make_alloc_ni(
  alloc_base,
  score_var = 0.9 * lambda_std + 0.1 * area_std,
  rule_name = "lambda_90_area_10",
  total_vol_ni = total_vol_ni
)

fr_alloc_lambda_area20 <- make_alloc_ni(
  alloc_base,
  score_var = 0.8 * lambda_std + 0.2 * area_std,
  rule_name = "lambda_80_area_20",
  total_vol_ni = total_vol_ni
)

fr_alloc_lambda_area025 <- make_alloc_ni(
  alloc_base,
  score_var = lambda * (area_km2 ^ 0.25),
  rule_name = "lambda_x_area_pow_0.25",
  total_vol_ni = total_vol_ni
)

fr_alloc_lambda_logarea <- make_alloc_ni(
  alloc_base,
  score_var = lambda * log1p(area_km2),
  rule_name = "lambda_x_log_area",
  total_vol_ni = total_vol_ni
)

# Fixed 31 per LGD using lambda
fr_alloc_lambda_within_LGD <- make_alloc_lgd(
  alloc_base,
  score_var = lambda,
  rule_name = "lambda_within_LGD",
  fr_per_lgd = 31
)

# Fixed 31 per LGD using lambda + area 
fr_alloc_lambda_area10_within_LGD <- make_alloc_lgd(
  alloc_base,
  score_var = 0.9 * lambda_std + 0.1 * area_std,
  rule_name = "lambda_90_area_10_within_LGD",
  fr_per_lgd = 31
)

fr_alloc_lambda_area20_within_LGD <- make_alloc_lgd(
  alloc_base,
  score_var = 0.8 * lambda_std + 0.2 * area_std,
  rule_name = "lambda_80_area_20_within_LGD",
  fr_per_lgd = 31
)

fr_alloc_lambda_area025_within_LGD <- make_alloc_lgd(
  alloc_base,
  score_var = lambda * (area_km2 ^ 0.25),
  rule_name = "lambda_x_area_pow_0.25_within_LGD",
  fr_per_lgd = 31
)

fr_alloc_lambda_logarea_within_LGD <- make_alloc_lgd(
  alloc_base,
  score_var = lambda * log1p(area_km2),
  rule_name = "lambda_x_log_area_within_LGD",
  fr_per_lgd = 31
)

# Fixed 31 per LGD random/equal 
fr_alloc_random_within_LGD <- alloc_base %>%
  group_by(lgd) %>%
  mutate(
    score = 1,
    raw_target = 31 * score / sum(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    fr_target = floor(raw_target),
    remainder = raw_target - fr_target
  ) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    d <- .x
    n_left <- 31 - sum(d$fr_target, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (n_left > 0) {
      add_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(d)), size = n_left)
      d$fr_target[add_idx] <- d$fr_target[add_idx] + 1
    }
    d
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(rule = "random_within_LGD")


# Combine all 
fr_alloc_all_rules <- bind_rows(
  fr_alloc_lambda_across_NI,
  fr_alloc_lambda_area10,
  fr_alloc_lambda_area20,
  fr_alloc_lambda_area025,
  fr_alloc_lambda_logarea,
  fr_alloc_lambda_within_LGD,
  fr_alloc_lambda_area10_within_LGD,
  fr_alloc_lambda_area20_within_LGD,
  fr_alloc_lambda_area025_within_LGD,
  fr_alloc_lambda_logarea_within_LGD,
  fr_alloc_random_within_LGD
)

fr_alloc_all_rules %>%
  group_by(rule) %>%
  summarise(total_fr = sum(fr_target, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

fr_alloc_all_rules %>%
  group_by(rule, lgd, lgd_name) %>%
  summarise(total_fr_lgd = sum(fr_target, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(rule, desc(total_fr_lgd))

fr_alloc_all_rules %>%
  filter(grepl("within_LGD", rule)) %>%
  group_by(rule, lgd, lgd_name) %>%
  summarise(total_fr_lgd = sum(fr_target, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(rule, lgd)

fixed_lgd_rules <- c(
  "lambda_within_LGD",
  "lambda_90_area_10_within_LGD",
  "lambda_80_area_20_within_LGD",
  "lambda_x_area_pow_0.25_within_LGD",
  "lambda_x_log_area_within_LGD",
  "random_within_LGD"
)
```

12. Helper function for cost:
```{r}
simulate_cairns_qalys <- function(n_additional_lives,
                                  study_months = 12,
                                  utility = 0.72,
                                  discount_rate = 0.03,
                                  mean_survival_years = 5.61,
                                  follow_months = 840) {
  prob_month_alive <- exp(-1 / (mean_survival_years * 12))
  total_qalys <- 0

  if (n_additional_lives <= 0) return(0)

  for (j in seq_len(n_additional_lives)) {
    month_saved <- sample(0:study_months, 1)

    # half-cycle correction in month of survival gain
    qaly_j <- ((1 / 12) * utility) /
      ((1 + discount_rate)^(month_saved / 12)) * 0.5

    alive <- TRUE

    for (m in seq_len(follow_months)) {
      if (!alive) break

      alive <- rbinom(1, 1, prob_month_alive) == 1

      if (alive) {
        qaly_j <- qaly_j +
          ((1 / 12) * utility) /
          ((1 + discount_rate)^((month_saved + m) / 12))
      }
    }

    total_qalys <- total_qalys + qaly_j
  }

  total_qalys
}
```

13. Precompute a sample of 50 FRs per datazone to sample from within the following function:
```{r}
set.seed(123)

dz_all_main <- NI_shapefile %>%
    sf::st_make_valid() %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      zone_count %>% dplyr::select(zone_code, count, lgd, lgd_name),
      by = "zone_code"
    ) 

zone_sf <- dz_all_main %>%
  select(zone_code, geometry) %>%
  distinct(zone_code, .keep_all = TRUE)

zone_point_bank_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(zone_sf)), function(i) {
  g <- st_geometry(zone_sf)[i]
  z <- zone_sf$zone_code[i]

  pts <- st_sample(g, size = 50)

  if (length(pts) == 0) {
    surf_pt <- st_point_on_surface(g)
    pts <- st_sfc(rep(list(surf_pt[[1]]), 50), crs = st_crs(zone_sf))
  } else {
    pts <- st_sfc(pts, crs = st_crs(zone_sf))
  }

  st_sf(
    zone_code = z,
    point_id = seq_along(pts),
    geometry = pts
  )
})

zone_point_bank <- do.call(rbind, zone_point_bank_list)

xy_bank <- st_coordinates(zone_point_bank)

zone_point_bank <- zone_point_bank %>%
  mutate(
    home_x = xy_bank[, 1],
    home_y = xy_bank[, 2]
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

zone_point_bank %>%
  count(zone_code) %>%
  summarise(
    min_points = min(n),
    max_points = max(n),
    mean_points = mean(n)
  )
```

```{r}
sample_age_from_band <- function(age_band) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    age_band == "1 (0–4 years)"   ~ sample(0:4, 1),
    age_band == "2 (5–9 years)"   ~ sample(5:9, 1),
    age_band == "3 (10–14 years)" ~ sample(10:14, 1),
    age_band == "4 (15–19 years)" ~ sample(15:19, 1),
    age_band == "5 (20–24 years)" ~ sample(20:24, 1),
    age_band == "6 (25–29 years)" ~ sample(25:29, 1),
    age_band == "7 (30–34 years)" ~ sample(30:34, 1),
    age_band == "8 (35–39 years)" ~ sample(35:39, 1),
    age_band == "9 (40–44 years)" ~ sample(40:44, 1),
    age_band == "10 (45–49 years)" ~ sample(45:49, 1),
    age_band == "11 (50–54 years)" ~ sample(50:54, 1),
    age_band == "12 (55–59 years)" ~ sample(55:59, 1),
    age_band == "13 (60–64 years)" ~ sample(60:64, 1),
    age_band == "14 (65–69 years)" ~ sample(65:69, 1),
    age_band == "15 (70–74 years)" ~ sample(70:74, 1),
    age_band == "16 (75–79 years)" ~ sample(75:79, 1),
    age_band == "17 (80–84 years)" ~ sample(80:84, 1),
    age_band == "18 (85–89 years)" ~ sample(85:89, 1),
    age_band == "19 (90+ years)"   ~ sample(90:100, 1),
    TRUE ~ 60L
  )
}

get_year_surv <- function(age_val, sex_val, life_table_yearly) {
  out <- life_table_yearly %>%
    filter(age == age_val, gender == sex_val) %>%
    pull(year_surv_rate)

  if (length(out) == 0 || is.na(out)) return(0.5)
  out
}

simulate_markov_micro <- function(age_band,
                                  gender,
                                  neuro_status,
                                  life_table_yearly,
                                  discount_rate = 0.03,
                                  horizon_years = 40,
                                  target_surv5_no_mild = 0.738,
                                  hr_no_mild = 1.00,
                                  hr_moderate = 1.57,
                                  hr_severe = 2.46,
                                  u_no_mild,
                                  u_moderate,
                                  u_severe,
                                  cost_hosp_no_mild,
                                  cost_hosp_moderate,
                                  cost_hosp_severe,
                                  cost_weekly_moderate,
                                  cost_weekly_severe,
                                  cost_icd_yearly) {

  age_start <- sample_age_from_band(age_band)

  utility <- dplyr::case_when(
    neuro_status == "no_mild" ~ u_no_mild,
    neuro_status == "moderate" ~ u_moderate,
    neuro_status == "severe" ~ u_severe,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )

  annual_cost <- dplyr::case_when(
    neuro_status == "no_mild" ~ cost_icd_yearly,
    neuro_status == "moderate" ~ 52 * cost_weekly_moderate,
    neuro_status == "severe" ~ 52 * cost_weekly_severe,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )

  hosp_cost <- dplyr::case_when(
    neuro_status == "no_mild" ~ cost_hosp_no_mild,
    neuro_status == "moderate" ~ cost_hosp_moderate,
    neuro_status == "severe" ~ cost_hosp_severe,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )

  hr_state <- dplyr::case_when(
    neuro_status == "no_mild" ~ hr_no_mild,
    neuro_status == "moderate" ~ hr_moderate,
    neuro_status == "severe" ~ hr_severe,
    TRUE ~ 1
  )

  # Calibrate a fixed post-arrest excess hazard at baseline so the no/mild group matches Dillenbeck's 5-year survival for CPC 1.
  base_surv5_start <- prod(sapply(0:4, function(k) {
    get_year_surv(min(age_start + k, 100L), gender, life_table_yearly)
  }))

  hr_post_arrest <- log(target_surv5_no_mild) / log(pmax(base_surv5_start, 1e-6))
  hr_post_arrest <- max(hr_post_arrest, 1)

  qaly <- 0
  cost <- hosp_cost
  alive <- TRUE

  for (t in seq_len(horizon_years)) {
    if (!alive) break

    age_t <- min(age_start + (t - 1), 100L)
    base_surv_t <- get_year_surv(age_t, gender, life_table_yearly)

    p_surv_year <- base_surv_t^(hr_post_arrest * hr_state)
    disc <- 1 / ((1 + discount_rate)^(t - 1))

    survive_full_year <- rbinom(1, 1, p_surv_year) == 1
    year_weight <- ifelse(survive_full_year, 1, 0.5)  # half-cycle correction

    qaly <- qaly + utility * disc * year_weight
    cost <- cost + annual_cost * disc * year_weight

    alive <- survive_full_year
  }

  c(qaly_gain = qaly, survivor_cost = cost)
}
```

14c. Helper to combine results from 5 different simulations into 1, representing 5 years:
```{r}
make_five_year_blocks <- function(sim_level_df, scheme_cost_is_already_5yr = TRUE) {
  
  sim_lookup <- tibble::tibble(
    sim = sort(unique(sim_level_df$sim)),
    sim_index = seq_along(sort(unique(sim_level_df$sim)))
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(block_id = ceiling(sim_index / 5))

  sim_level_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(sim_lookup, by = "sim") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(block_id) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_years_in_block = dplyr::n_distinct(sim),
      lives_saved_5yr = sum(sim_lives_saved_year, na.rm = TRUE),
      qalys_5yr = sum(sim_qalys_year, na.rm = TRUE),
      survivor_cost_5yr = sum(sim_survivor_cost_year, na.rm = TRUE),
      scheme_cost_5yr = if (scheme_cost_is_already_5yr) {
        dplyr::first(sim_scheme_cost_year)
      } else {
        sum(sim_scheme_cost_year, na.rm = TRUE)
      },
      total_cost_5yr = scheme_cost_5yr + survivor_cost_5yr,
      icer_5yr = ifelse(qalys_5yr > 0, total_cost_5yr / qalys_5yr, NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
```

14.d Helper to generate FR allocations per sim for the random rules e.g random across NI:
```{r}
set.seed(123)

random_zone_assignments <- sample(
  alloc_base$zone_code,
  size = total_vol_ni,
  replace = TRUE
)

fr_alloc_random_across_NI_true <- tibble(zone_code = random_zone_assignments) %>%
  count(zone_code, name = "fr_target") %>%
  right_join(alloc_base, by = "zone_code") %>%
  mutate(
    fr_target = ifelse(is.na(fr_target), 0L, fr_target),
    rule = "random_across_NI_true"
  )

make_random_within_lgd_alloc <- function(alloc_base, fr_per_lgd = 31) {
  alloc_base %>%
    dplyr::group_by(lgd) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      score = 1,
      raw_target = fr_per_lgd / dplyr::n(),
      fr_target = floor(raw_target),
      remainder = raw_target - fr_target
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(~{
      d <- .x
      n_left <- fr_per_lgd - sum(d$fr_target, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (n_left > 0) {
        add_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(d)), size = n_left)
        d$fr_target[add_idx] <- d$fr_target[add_idx] + 1
      }
      d
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(rule = "random_within_LGD")
}

make_random_across_ni_alloc <- function(alloc_base, total_vol_ni = 806) {
  random_zone_assignments <- sample(
    alloc_base$zone_code,
    size = total_vol_ni,
    replace = TRUE
  )

  tibble::tibble(zone_code = random_zone_assignments) %>%
    dplyr::count(zone_code, name = "fr_target") %>%
    dplyr::right_join(alloc_base, by = "zone_code") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      fr_target = ifelse(is.na(fr_target), 0L, fr_target),
      rule = "random_across_NI"
    )
}


generate_random_allocations_by_sim <- function(rule_name,  #here
                                               alloc_base,
                                               sim_ids,
                                               total_vol_ni = 806,
                                               fr_per_lgd = 31,
                                               seed = 1) {

  out <- vector("list", length(sim_ids))
  names(out) <- as.character(sim_ids)

  for (i in seq_along(sim_ids)) {
    set.seed(seed + i)

    out[[i]] <- switch(
      rule_name,
      "random_within_LGD" = make_random_within_lgd_alloc(
        alloc_base = alloc_base,
        fr_per_lgd = fr_per_lgd
      ),
      "random_across_NI" = make_random_across_ni_alloc(
        alloc_base = alloc_base,
        total_vol_ni = total_vol_ni
      ),
      stop("generate_random_allocations_by_sim() only supports random rules.")
    )
  }

  out
}
```

14.e Helper for FR response:
```{r}
process_week_fr <- function(w,
                            df_sim,
                            volunteers,
                            n_cohorts,
                            radius_m,
                            p_respond,
                            k_decay,
                            dispatch_sens,
                            p_gear) {

  A <- df_sim %>% dplyr::filter(week == w)
  if (nrow(A) == 0) return(NULL)

  active_cohort <- ((w - 1) %% n_cohorts) + 1
  R <- volunteers %>% dplyr::filter(cohort == active_cohort)
  if (nrow(R) == 0) return(NULL)

  dx <- outer(A$coa_easting, R$home_x, "-")
  dy <- outer(A$coa_northing, R$home_y, "-")
  dist_m_mat <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2)

  within_idx <- which(dist_m_mat <= radius_m, arr.ind = TRUE)
  if (nrow(within_idx) == 0) return(NULL)

  pairs <- tibble::tibble(
    arrest_row_local = within_idx[, 1],
    responder_row_local = within_idx[, 2],
    dist_m = dist_m_mat[within_idx]
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      dist_miles = dist_m / 1609.344,
      p_resp_dist = p_respond * exp(-k_decay * dist_miles),
      p_resp_dist = pmin(pmax(p_resp_dist, 0), 1),
      sim_row_id = A$sim_row_id[arrest_row_local],
      volunteer_id = R$volunteer_id[responder_row_local],
      week = w
    )

  # dispatch applied ONCE per arrest
  dispatch_by_event <- tibble::tibble(
    sim_row_id = sort(unique(pairs$sim_row_id)),
    dispatched = rbinom(length(unique(pairs$sim_row_id)), 1, dispatch_sens)
  )

  pairs <- pairs %>%
    dplyr::left_join(dispatch_by_event, by = "sim_row_id") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      got_gear = ifelse(dispatched == 1, rbinom(dplyr::n(), 1, p_gear), 0),
      responded = ifelse(got_gear == 1, rbinom(dplyr::n(), 1, p_resp_dist), 0)
    )

  pairs
}
```


*Main function that runs everything per LGD* 

15. Function that runs the simulation across all LGDs based on a FR allocation scheme, assigning neurological impairment etc, calculates QALY and other metrics, and then calculates cost:
```{r}
#Checklist of helpers before running:
exists("process_week_fr")
exists("make_random_within_lgd_alloc")
exists("make_random_across_ni_alloc")
exists("generate_random_allocations_by_sim")
exists("run_rule_lgd")

run_one_lgd_vary_qaly <- function(target_lgd,
                                  df2, zone_count, NI_shapefile, fr_alloc = NULL,
                                  fr_alloc_by_sim = NULL,
                                  zone_point_bank,
                                  life_table_yearly,
                                  weeks = 52, rota_len = 4,
                                  radius_miles = 15,
                                  p_gear = 0.8, p_respond = 0.3, dispatch_sens = 0.4,
                                  k_decay = 0.1,
                                  b0 = 1.8790657182, b1 = 0.2971864133,
                                  b2 = 0.2934664770, sigma = 0.2983923496,
                                  discount_rate = 0.03,
                                  markov_horizon = 70,
                                  target_surv5_no_mild = 0.738,
                                  hr_no_mild = 1.00,
                                  hr_moderate = 1.57,
                                  hr_severe = 2.46,
                                  u_no_mild,
                                  u_moderate,
                                  u_severe,
                                  cost_scheme_5yr,
                                  cost_hosp_no_mild,
                                  cost_hosp_moderate,
                                  cost_hosp_severe,
                                  cost_weekly_moderate,
                                  cost_weekly_severe,
                                  cost_icd_yearly,
                                  p_no_mild,
                                  p_moderate,
                                  p_severe,
                                  seed = 1,
                                  return_sim_level = FALSE,
                                  max_sims = NULL) {

  # a) Setup
  set.seed(seed)
  radius_m <- radius_miles * 1609.344

  # b) Build LGD base zone table WITHOUT attaching FR targets yet
  #    FR counts are attached inside each simulation year so that
  #    simulation-specific random allocations can be supported.
  dz_w <- dz_all_main %>%
    dplyr::filter(lgd == target_lgd) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      count = ifelse(is.na(count) | count < 0, 0, count)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(count > 0)

  lgd_population <- sum(dz_w$count, na.rm = TRUE)
  lgd_area_km2 <- if (nrow(dz_w) > 0) {
    as.numeric(sf::st_area(sf::st_union(dz_w$geometry))) / 1e6
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  if (nrow(dz_w) == 0) {
    empty_out <- tibble::tibble(
      lgd_code = target_lgd,
      lgd_name = NA_character_,
      lgd_population = 0,
      lgd_area_km2 = NA_real_,
      n_arrests = 0L,
      n_vol = 0L,
      n_per_week = 0L,
      total_lives_saved = 0,
      total_qalys_gained = 0,
      total_survivor_cost = 0,
      avg_ambulance_time = NA_real_,
      avg_ambulance_plus_FR_time = NA_real_,
      mean_lives_saved_per_year = NA_real_,
      mean_qalys_gained_per_year = NA_real_,
      mean_survivor_cost_per_year = NA_real_,
      mean_scheme_cost_per_year = NA_real_,
      mean_total_cost_per_year = NA_real_,
      mean_icer = NA_real_,
      icer_from_means = NA_real_,
      mean_surv_base_year = NA_real_,
      mean_surv_FR_year = NA_real_
    )

    if (return_sim_level) {
      return(list(summary = empty_out, sim_level = tibble::tibble()))
    } else {
      return(empty_out)
    }
  }

  # c) Baseline arrests in this LGD
  df_lgd <- df2 %>%
    dplyr::filter(lgd == target_lgd)

  if (!is.null(max_sims)) {
    sims_keep <- sort(unique(df_lgd$sim))[seq_len(min(max_sims, dplyr::n_distinct(df_lgd$sim)))]
    df_lgd <- df_lgd %>%
      dplyr::filter(sim %in% sims_keep)
  }

  if (nrow(df_lgd) == 0) {
    empty_out <- tibble::tibble(
      lgd_code = target_lgd,
      lgd_name = dplyr::first(dz_w$lgd_name),
      lgd_population = lgd_population,
      lgd_area_km2 = lgd_area_km2,
      n_arrests = 0L,
      n_vol = NA_real_,
      n_per_week = NA_real_,
      total_lives_saved = 0,
      total_qalys_gained = 0,
      total_survivor_cost = 0,
      avg_ambulance_time = NA_real_,
      avg_ambulance_plus_FR_time = NA_real_,
      mean_lives_saved_per_year = NA_real_,
      mean_qalys_gained_per_year = NA_real_,
      mean_survivor_cost_per_year = NA_real_,
      mean_scheme_cost_per_year = NA_real_,
      mean_total_cost_per_year = NA_real_,
      mean_icer = NA_real_,
      icer_from_means = NA_real_,
      mean_surv_base_year = NA_real_,
      mean_surv_FR_year = NA_real_
    )

    if (return_sim_level) {
      return(list(summary = empty_out, sim_level = tibble::tibble()))
    } else {
      return(empty_out)
    }
  }

  if (!"sim" %in% names(df_lgd)) {
    stop("df2 must contain a 'sim' column.")
  }

  sim_ids <- sort(unique(df_lgd$sim))

  # d) Run one simulated year at a time
  sim_results <- lapply(seq_along(sim_ids), function(ii) {
    sim_id <- sim_ids[ii]
    set.seed(seed + ii)

    df_sim <- df_lgd %>%
      dplyr::filter(sim == sim_id) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        week = sample(1:weeks, size = dplyr::n(), replace = TRUE),
        sim_row_id = dplyr::row_number()
      )

    if (nrow(df_sim) == 0) {
      return(tibble::tibble())
    }

    # e) Attach simulation-specific FR allocation
    if (!is.null(fr_alloc_by_sim)) {

      fr_alloc_sim <- fr_alloc_by_sim[[as.character(sim_id)]]

      if (is.null(fr_alloc_sim)) {
        stop(paste("No fr_alloc_by_sim entry found for sim", sim_id))
      }

      fr_alloc_small_sim <- fr_alloc_sim %>%
        dplyr::ungroup() %>%
        dplyr::transmute(zone_code, fr_target)

    } else {

      if (is.null(fr_alloc)) {
        stop("Either fr_alloc or fr_alloc_by_sim must be supplied.")
      }

      fr_alloc_small_sim <- fr_alloc %>%
        dplyr::ungroup() %>%
        dplyr::transmute(zone_code, fr_target)
    }

    fr_counts_sim <- dz_w %>%
      sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
      dplyr::select(zone_code) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(fr_alloc_small_sim, by = "zone_code") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        fr_target = ifelse(is.na(fr_target), 0L, fr_target)
      )

    n_vol_sim <- sum(fr_counts_sim$fr_target, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_cohorts_sim <- ifelse(n_vol_sim < rota_len, 1, rota_len)
    n_per_week_sim <- ceiling(n_vol_sim / n_cohorts_sim)

    # f) Fresh FR roster/home points for this simulation year
    if (n_vol_sim > 0) {
      vol <- fr_counts_sim %>%
        tidyr::uncount(fr_target) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          volunteer_id = dplyr::row_number(),
          cohort = rep(1:n_cohorts_sim, length.out = dplyr::n())
        )

      volunteers <- vol %>%
        dplyr::left_join(zone_point_bank, by = "zone_code") %>%
        dplyr::group_by(volunteer_id, cohort, zone_code) %>%
        dplyr::slice_sample(n = 1) %>%
        dplyr::ungroup() %>%
        dplyr::select(volunteer_id, cohort, zone_code, home_x, home_y)

      if (any(is.na(volunteers$home_x)) || any(is.na(volunteers$home_y))) {
        stop("Missing home coordinates after joining zone_point_bank.")
      }
    }

    # g) Weekly FR paging and response using external helper
    if (n_vol_sim == 0) {
      df_best <- df_sim %>% dplyr::mutate(t_best = T_sim)

    } else {

      pair_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
        lapply(
          sort(unique(df_sim$week)),
          process_week_fr,
          df_sim = df_sim,
          volunteers = volunteers,
          n_cohorts = n_cohorts_sim,
          radius_m = radius_m,
          p_respond = p_respond,
          k_decay = k_decay,
          dispatch_sens = dispatch_sens,
          p_gear = p_gear
        )
      )

      if (is.null(pair_results) || nrow(pair_results) == 0) {
        df_best <- df_sim %>% dplyr::mutate(t_best = T_sim)

      } else {
        responded_long <- pair_results %>%
          dplyr::filter(responded == 1) %>%
          dplyr::left_join(
            df_sim %>% dplyr::select(sim_row_id, Urban_status),
            by = "sim_row_id"
          ) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            dist_for_log = pmax(dist_miles, 1e-6),
            mu_fr = b0 + b1 * log(dist_for_log) + b2 * Urban_status,
            u = runif(dplyr::n()),
            FR_time = exp(mu_fr + sigma * qlogis(u))
          )

        fr_best <- responded_long %>%
          dplyr::group_by(sim_row_id) %>%
          dplyr::summarise(fr_time_min = min(FR_time), .groups = "drop")

        df_best <- df_sim %>%
          dplyr::left_join(fr_best, by = "sim_row_id") %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            fr_time_min = ifelse(is.na(fr_time_min), Inf, fr_time_min),
            t_best = pmin(T_sim, fr_time_min)
          )
      }
    }

    # h) Survival comparison for this simulated year
    comparison <- df_sim %>%
      dplyr::select(sim_row_id, sim, age_band, gender, T0 = T_sim) %>%
      dplyr::inner_join(
        df_best %>% dplyr::select(sim_row_id, T1 = t_best),
        by = "sim_row_id"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(U_surv = runif(dplyr::n())) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        IDEFIB0 = T0 + 1,
        ICPR0   = T0 + 2,
        p_base = plogis(-0.260 - 0.106 * ICPR0 - 0.139 * IDEFIB0),
        IDEFIB1 = T1 + 1,
        ICPR1   = T1 + 2,
        p_FR = plogis(-0.260 - 0.106 * ICPR1 - 0.139 * IDEFIB1),
        y_base = as.integer(U_surv < p_base),
        y_FR   = as.integer(U_surv < p_FR),
        dy = y_FR - y_base
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        neuro_status = NA_character_,
        qaly_gain = 0,
        survivor_cost = 0
      )

    # i) Assign neurological state and run microsimulation only for incremental survivors
    idx <- which(comparison$dy == 1)

    if (length(idx) > 0) {
      comparison$neuro_status[idx] <- sample(
        c("no_mild", "moderate", "severe"),
        size = length(idx),
        replace = TRUE,
        prob = c(p_no_mild, p_moderate, p_severe)
      )

      micro_out <- t(vapply(idx, function(j) {
        simulate_markov_micro(
          age_band = comparison$age_band[j],
          gender = comparison$gender[j],
          neuro_status = comparison$neuro_status[j],
          life_table_yearly = life_table_yearly,
          discount_rate = discount_rate,
          horizon_years = markov_horizon,
          target_surv5_no_mild = target_surv5_no_mild,
          hr_no_mild = hr_no_mild,
          hr_moderate = hr_moderate,
          hr_severe = hr_severe,
          u_no_mild = u_no_mild,
          u_moderate = u_moderate,
          u_severe = u_severe,
          cost_hosp_no_mild = cost_hosp_no_mild,
          cost_hosp_moderate = cost_hosp_moderate,
          cost_hosp_severe = cost_hosp_severe,
          cost_weekly_moderate = cost_weekly_moderate,
          cost_weekly_severe = cost_weekly_severe,
          cost_icd_yearly = cost_icd_yearly
        )
      }, numeric(2)))

      comparison$qaly_gain[idx] <- micro_out[, "qaly_gain"]
      comparison$survivor_cost[idx] <- micro_out[, "survivor_cost"]
    }

    # j) Summarise this simulated year
    sim_lives_saved_year <- sum(comparison$dy, na.rm = TRUE)
    sim_qalys_year <- sum(comparison$qaly_gain, na.rm = TRUE)
    sim_survivor_cost_year <- sum(comparison$survivor_cost, na.rm = TRUE)

    # yearly mean predicted survival rates
    sim_surv_base_year <- mean(comparison$p_base, na.rm = TRUE)
    sim_surv_FR_year   <- mean(comparison$p_FR,   na.rm = TRUE)

    scheme_cost_5yr_lgd <- cost_scheme_5yr
    scheme_cost_per_year_lgd <- scheme_cost_5yr_lgd

    sim_total_cost_year <- scheme_cost_per_year_lgd + sim_survivor_cost_year
    sim_icer <- ifelse(sim_qalys_year > 0,
                       sim_total_cost_year / sim_qalys_year,
                       NA_real_)

    tibble::tibble(
      sim = sim_id,
      n_arrests = nrow(comparison),
      n_vol = n_vol_sim,
      n_per_week = n_per_week_sim,
      avg_ambulance_time = mean(comparison$T0, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_ambulance_plus_FR_time = mean(comparison$T1, na.rm = TRUE),
      sim_surv_base_year = sim_surv_base_year,
      sim_surv_FR_year = sim_surv_FR_year,
      sim_lives_saved_year = sim_lives_saved_year,
      sim_qalys_year = sim_qalys_year,
      sim_survivor_cost_year = sim_survivor_cost_year,
      sim_scheme_cost_year = scheme_cost_per_year_lgd,
      sim_total_cost_year = sim_total_cost_year,
      sim_icer = sim_icer
    )
  })

  # k) Bind yearly results across simulations
  by_year <- dplyr::bind_rows(sim_results)
  
  q025 <- function(x) stats::quantile(x, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
  q975 <- function(x) stats::quantile(x, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)

  # l) LGD-level summary
  summary_out <- tibble::tibble(
  lgd_code = target_lgd,
  lgd_name = dplyr::first(dz_w$lgd_name),
  lgd_population = lgd_population,
  lgd_area_km2 = lgd_area_km2,
  n_arrests = sum(by_year$n_arrests, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_vol = mean(by_year$n_vol, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_per_week = mean(by_year$n_per_week, na.rm = TRUE),

  total_lives_saved = sum(by_year$sim_lives_saved_year, na.rm = TRUE),
  total_qalys_gained = sum(by_year$sim_qalys_year, na.rm = TRUE),
  total_survivor_cost = sum(by_year$sim_survivor_cost_year, na.rm = TRUE),

  avg_ambulance_time = mean(by_year$avg_ambulance_time, na.rm = TRUE),
  avg_ambulance_plus_FR_time = mean(by_year$avg_ambulance_plus_FR_time, na.rm = TRUE),

  mean_surv_base_year = mean(by_year$sim_surv_base_year, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_surv_base_year_lo = q025(by_year$sim_surv_base_year),
  mean_surv_base_year_hi = q975(by_year$sim_surv_base_year),

  mean_surv_FR_year = mean(by_year$sim_surv_FR_year, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_surv_FR_year_lo = q025(by_year$sim_surv_FR_year),
  mean_surv_FR_year_hi = q975(by_year$sim_surv_FR_year),

  mean_lives_saved_per_year = mean(by_year$sim_lives_saved_year, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_lives_saved_per_year_lo = q025(by_year$sim_lives_saved_year),
  mean_lives_saved_per_year_hi = q975(by_year$sim_lives_saved_year),

  mean_qalys_gained_per_year = mean(by_year$sim_qalys_year, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_qalys_gained_per_year_lo = q025(by_year$sim_qalys_year),
  mean_qalys_gained_per_year_hi = q975(by_year$sim_qalys_year),

  mean_survivor_cost_per_year = mean(by_year$sim_survivor_cost_year, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_survivor_cost_per_year_lo = q025(by_year$sim_survivor_cost_year),
  mean_survivor_cost_per_year_hi = q975(by_year$sim_survivor_cost_year),

  mean_scheme_cost_per_year = mean(by_year$sim_scheme_cost_year, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_scheme_cost_per_year_lo = q025(by_year$sim_scheme_cost_year),
  mean_scheme_cost_per_year_hi = q975(by_year$sim_scheme_cost_year),

  mean_total_cost_per_year = mean(by_year$sim_total_cost_year, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_total_cost_per_year_lo = q025(by_year$sim_total_cost_year),
  mean_total_cost_per_year_hi = q975(by_year$sim_total_cost_year),

  mean_icer = mean(by_year$sim_icer, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_icer_lo = q025(by_year$sim_icer),
  mean_icer_hi = q975(by_year$sim_icer),

  icer_from_means = mean(by_year$sim_total_cost_year, na.rm = TRUE) /
    mean(by_year$sim_qalys_year, na.rm = TRUE),

  avg_ambulance_time_lo = q025(by_year$avg_ambulance_time),
  avg_ambulance_time_hi = q975(by_year$avg_ambulance_time),

  avg_ambulance_plus_FR_time_lo = q025(by_year$avg_ambulance_plus_FR_time),
  avg_ambulance_plus_FR_time_hi = q975(by_year$avg_ambulance_plus_FR_time)
)
  
  #Nice and pretty output
  summary_out <- summary_out %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lives_saved_display = sprintf(
      "%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
      mean_lives_saved_per_year,
      mean_lives_saved_per_year_lo,
      mean_lives_saved_per_year_hi
    ),
    qalys_display = sprintf(
      "%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
      mean_qalys_gained_per_year,
      mean_qalys_gained_per_year_lo,
      mean_qalys_gained_per_year_hi
    ),
    total_cost_display = sprintf(
      "£%s (£%s, £%s)",
      format(round(mean_total_cost_per_year, 0), big.mark = ","),
      format(round(mean_total_cost_per_year_lo, 0), big.mark = ","),
      format(round(mean_total_cost_per_year_hi, 0), big.mark = ",")
    ),
    icer_display = sprintf(
      "£%s (£%s, £%s)",
      format(round(mean_icer, 0), big.mark = ","),
      format(round(mean_icer_lo, 0), big.mark = ","),
      format(round(mean_icer_hi, 0), big.mark = ",")
    )
  )

  if (return_sim_level) {
    sim_out <- by_year %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        lgd_code = target_lgd,
        lgd_name = dplyr::first(dz_w$lgd_name)
      )
    return(list(summary = summary_out, sim_level = sim_out))
  } else {
    return(summary_out)
  }
}
```


Common arguments for this function:
```{r}


lgds <- sort(unique(zone_count$lgd))
all_rules <- unique(fr_alloc_all_rules$rule)

main_rules <- c(
  "lambda_across_NI",
  "lambda_within_LGD",
  "random_within_LGD"
)

common_args <- list(
  zone_count = zone_count,
  NI_shapefile = NI_shapefile,
  zone_point_bank = zone_point_bank,
  life_table_yearly = life_table_yearly,
  weeks = 52,
  rota_len = 4,
  radius_miles = 15,
  p_gear = 0.8,
  p_respond = 0.3,
  dispatch_sens = 0.4,
  k_decay = 0.1,
  b0 = 1.8790657182,
  b1 = 0.2971864133,
  b2 = 0.2934664770,
  sigma = 0.2983923496,
  discount_rate = 0.03,
  markov_horizon = 70,
  target_surv5_no_mild = 0.738,
  hr_no_mild = 1.00,
  hr_moderate = 1.57,
  hr_severe = 2.46,
  u_no_mild = u_no_mild,
  u_moderate = u_moderate,
  u_severe = u_severe,
  cost_scheme_5yr = cost_scheme_5yr,
  cost_hosp_no_mild = cost_hosp_no_mild,
  cost_hosp_moderate = cost_hosp_moderate,
  cost_hosp_severe = cost_hosp_severe,
  cost_weekly_moderate = cost_weekly_moderate,
  cost_weekly_severe = cost_weekly_severe,
  cost_icd_yearly = cost_icd_yearly,
  p_no_mild = p_no_mild,
  p_moderate = p_moderate,
  p_severe = p_severe
)

run_rule_lgd <- function(rule_name, target_lgd, df2_use, seed,
                         return_sim_level = FALSE,
                         max_sims = NULL) {

  sims_use <- sort(unique(df2_use$sim))
  if (!is.null(max_sims)) {
    sims_use <- sims_use[seq_len(min(max_sims, length(sims_use)))]
  }

  df2_use <- df2_use %>%
    dplyr::filter(sim %in% sims_use)

  if (rule_name %in% c("random_within_LGD", "random_across_NI")) {

    fr_alloc_by_sim <- generate_random_allocations_by_sim(
      rule_name = rule_name,
      alloc_base = alloc_base,
      sim_ids = sims_use,
      total_vol_ni = total_vol_ni,
      fr_per_lgd = 31,
      seed = seed
    )

    do.call(
      run_one_lgd_vary_qaly,
      c(
        list(
          target_lgd = target_lgd,
          df2 = df2_use,
          fr_alloc = NULL,
          fr_alloc_by_sim = fr_alloc_by_sim,
          seed = seed,
          return_sim_level = return_sim_level,
          max_sims = max_sims
        ),
        common_args
      )
    )

  } else {

    fr_alloc_rule <- fr_alloc_all_rules %>%
      dplyr::filter(rule == rule_name)

    do.call(
      run_one_lgd_vary_qaly,
      c(
        list(
          target_lgd = target_lgd,
          df2 = df2_use,
          fr_alloc = fr_alloc_rule,
          fr_alloc_by_sim = NULL,
          seed = seed,
          return_sim_level = return_sim_level,
          max_sims = max_sims
        ),
        common_args
      )
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Best LGD by response time improvement and proportion saved
# Using the lambda_within_LGD rule from the 20-sim screening

lgd_screening <- results_all_rules_lgd_20 %>%
  filter(rule == "lambda_within_LGD") %>%
  mutate(
    rt_improvement     = avg_ambulance_time - avg_ambulance_plus_FR_time,
    rt_improvement_pct = 100 * rt_improvement / avg_ambulance_time,
    prop_saved         = ifelse(mean_arrests_per_year > 0,
```

17e. Identifying the best rule:
```{r}


fixed31_rules <- c("lambda_within_LGD", "random_within_LGD")

results_fixed31_lgd_20 <- results_all_rules_lgd_20 %>%
  filter(rule %in% fixed31_rules)

#Note: Mean of simulation net monetary benefit (NMB) is the same as NMB from mean QALYs gained and cost

lgd_ranking_fixed31 <- results_fixed31_lgd_20 %>%
  filter(mean_qalys_gained_per_year > 0.001) %>%
  mutate(
    icer_from_means = mean_total_cost_per_year / mean_qalys_gained_per_year,
    nmb_20000 = 20000 * mean_qalys_gained_per_year - mean_total_cost_per_year,
    nmb_30000 = 30000 * mean_qalys_gained_per_year - mean_total_cost_per_year,
    nmb_35000 = 35000 * mean_qalys_gained_per_year - mean_total_cost_per_year
  )

#Ranking
best_lgd_by_icer <- lgd_ranking_fixed31 %>%
  arrange(icer_from_means)

best_lgd_by_nmb_20 <- lgd_ranking_fixed31 %>%
  arrange(desc(nmb_20000))

best_lgd_by_nmb_30 <- lgd_ranking_fixed31 %>%
  arrange(desc(nmb_30000))

best_lgd_by_nmb_35 <- lgd_ranking_fixed31 %>%
  arrange(desc(nmb_35000))

best_lgd_by_icer
best_lgd_by_nmb_20
best_lgd_by_nmb_30
best_lgd_by_nmb_35
```


18a. Running the sim for only the best rule (lambda_across_ni) across 1000 simulations across all LGDs:
```{r warning=FALSE}

df2_500 <- subset_first_sims(df2, 500)

ni_lambda_across_sim <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(lgds), function(i) {
  out <- run_rule_lgd(
    rule_name = "lambda_across_NI",
    target_lgd = lgds[i],
    df2_use = df2,
    seed = 50000 + i,
    return_sim_level = TRUE,
    max_sims = 1000
  )

  out$sim_level %>%
    mutate(
      rule = "lambda_across_NI",
      lgd_code = lgds[i]
    )
}))

#Aggregate to NI level
ni_lambda_across_yearly <- ni_lambda_across_sim %>%
  group_by(sim) %>%
  summarise(
    sim_lives_saved_year = sum(sim_lives_saved_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    sim_qalys_year = sum(sim_qalys_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    sim_survivor_cost_year = sum(sim_survivor_cost_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    sim_scheme_cost_year = sum(sim_scheme_cost_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    sim_total_cost_year = sum(sim_total_cost_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Convert to 5 year block
ni_lambda_across_5yr <- make_five_year_blocks(
  ni_lambda_across_yearly,
  scheme_cost_is_already_5yr = TRUE
)

ni_lambda_across_5yr
```

18b. CIs and summary for the above run
```{r}
# Survival and response time CIs for the 3 focal LGDs
lambda_within_sim %>%
  filter(lgd_code %in% c("95PP", "95HH", "95GG")) %>%
  group_by(lgd_code) %>%
  summarise(
    # EMS response time
    mean_amb      = mean(avg_ambulance_time,         na.rm = TRUE),
    lo_amb        = quantile(avg_ambulance_time,      0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    hi_amb        = quantile(avg_ambulance_time,      0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    # EMS + FR response time
    mean_fr       = mean(avg_ambulance_plus_FR_time,  na.rm = TRUE),
    lo_fr         = quantile(avg_ambulance_plus_FR_time, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    hi_fr         = quantile(avg_ambulance_plus_FR_time, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    # EMS survival
    mean_surv_ems = mean(sim_surv_base_year,          na.rm = TRUE),
    lo_surv_ems   = quantile(sim_surv_base_year,      0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    hi_surv_ems   = quantile(sim_surv_base_year,      0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    # EMS + FR survival
    mean_surv_fr  = mean(sim_surv_FR_year,            na.rm = TRUE),
    lo_surv_fr    = quantile(sim_surv_FR_year,        0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    hi_surv_fr    = quantile(sim_surv_FR_year,        0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Lives saved
    mean_lives    = mean(sim_lives_saved_year,        na.rm = TRUE),
    lo_lives      = quantile(sim_lives_saved_year,    0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    hi_lives      = quantile(sim_lives_saved_year,    0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    # QALYs
    mean_qalys    = mean(sim_qalys_year,              na.rm = TRUE),
    lo_qalys      = quantile(sim_qalys_year,          0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    hi_qalys      = quantile(sim_qalys_year,          0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print(width = Inf)

correct_icer

```

```{r}
wtp_grid <- seq(0, 50000, by = 1000)

ni_lambda_ceac <- tibble(

  prob_cost_effective = sapply(wtp_grid, function(k) {

  })
)


# Combine the two CEAC datasets
ceac_plot <- bind_rows(
  ni_random_ceac %>%
    mutate(series = "Base case"),
  ni_lambda_ceac %>%
    mutate(series = "Scenario 2")
)

# Colours
col_before <- "green"
col_after  <- "purple"

# Force threshold legend order
band_levels <- c(
  "New NICE willingness-to-pay threshold",
  "Old NICE willingness-to-pay threshold"
)

# Threshold regions:
# 20k–25k  = NICE up to Apr 2026 only
# 25k–30k  = overlap, shown as mixed/patterned
# 30k–35k  = NICE after Apr 2026 only
region_left <- tibble(
  xmin = 20000, xmax = 25000,
  ymin = 0, ymax = 1,
  band = factor("Old NICE willingness-to-pay threshold", levels = band_levels)
)

region_mid <- tibble(
  xmin = 25000, xmax = 30000,
  ymin = 0, ymax = 1
)

region_right <- tibble(
  xmin = 30000, xmax = 35000,
  ymin = 0, ymax = 1,
  band = factor("New NICE willingness-to-pay threshold", levels = band_levels)
)

# Dummy data just to create a clean threshold legend
threshold_legend <- tibble(
  xmin = c(0, 0),
  xmax = c(0, 0),
  ymin = c(0, 0),
  ymax = c(0, 0),
  band = factor(
    c(
      "New NICE willingness-to-pay threshold",
      "Old NICE willingness-to-pay threshold"
    ),
    levels = band_levels
  )
)

ggplot() +
  # Left region: old threshold only
  geom_rect(
    data = region_left,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = band),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.20,
    colour = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # Middle overlap region: mixed colours with diagonal stripes
  ggpattern::geom_rect_pattern(
    data = region_mid,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = col_before,
    alpha = 0.20,
    pattern = "stripe",
    pattern_angle = 45,
    pattern_spacing = 0.03,
    pattern_density = 0.45,
    pattern_fill = col_after,
    pattern_colour = col_after,
    pattern_alpha = 0.20,
    colour = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # Right region: new threshold only
  geom_rect(
    data = region_right,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = band),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.20,
    colour = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # Dummy layer for proper threshold legend
  geom_rect(
    data = threshold_legend,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = band),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.20,
    colour = NA
  ) +

  # CEAC lines
  geom_line(
    data = ceac_plot,
    aes(x = wtp, y = prob_cost_effective, colour = series, linetype = series),
    linewidth = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_dollar(prefix = "£", big.mark = ","),
    breaks = seq(10000, max(ceac_plot$wtp, na.rm = TRUE), by = 5000),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(10000, NA)) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    name = "Curve",
    values = c(
      "Base case" = "cyan",
      "Scenario 2" = "#FFD700"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Base case" = "FRs randomly distributed",
      "Scenario 2" = "FRs distributed weighted by expected annual SCAs"
    )
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "Curve",
    values = c(
      "Base case" = "solid",
      "Scenario 2" = "64"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Base case" = "FRs randomly distributed",
      "Scenario 2" = "FRs distributed weighted by expected annual SCAs"
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Threshold region",
    limits = band_levels,
    values = c(
      "New NICE willingness-to-pay threshold" = col_after,
      "Old NICE willingness-to-pay threshold" = col_before
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Willingness-to-pay threshold (£ per QALY)",
    y = "Probability cost-effective",
    colour = "Curve",
    linetype = "Curve",
    fill = "Threshold region"
  ) +

  guides(
    linetype = "none"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, colour = "grey30"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8.5),
    legend.box.spacing = grid::unit(0.1, "lines"),
    legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.1, "lines"),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
lambda_within_summ <- lambda_within_sim %>%
  group_by(lgd_code, lgd_name) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_lives_saved_per_year = mean(sim_lives_saved_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_qalys_gained_per_year = mean(sim_qalys_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_survivor_cost_per_year = mean(sim_survivor_cost_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_scheme_cost_per_year = mean(sim_scheme_cost_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_total_cost_per_year = mean(sim_total_cost_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_icer = mean(sim_icer, na.rm = TRUE),
    icer_from_means = mean(sim_total_cost_year, na.rm = TRUE) /
      mean(sim_qalys_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_arrests_per_year = mean(n_arrests, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ambulance_time = mean(avg_ambulance_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ambulance_plus_FR_time = mean(avg_ambulance_plus_FR_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_vol = mean(n_vol, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Build LGD info again
lgd_meta <- zone_count %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(lgd, lgd_name) %>%
  summarise(
    lgd_population = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lgd_area <- NI_shapefile %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  left_join(
    zone_values %>%
      select(zone_code, lgd, lgd_name) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = "zone_code"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lgd)) %>%
  group_by(lgd, lgd_name) %>%
  summarise(.groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    lgd_area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(lgd, lgd_name, lgd_area_km2)

lgd_meta <- lgd_meta %>%
  left_join(lgd_area, by = c("lgd", "lgd_name"))

lgd_meta

#Getting FR count for the lambda rule again (just double checking)

rule_to_plot <- "lambda_within_lgd"

fr_lgd <- fr_alloc_all_rules %>%
  filter(rule == rule_to_plot) %>%
   group_by(rule, lgd, lgd_name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_fr_lgd = sum(fr_target, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Build LGD master plotting table
plot_lgd_master <- lambda_within_summ %>%
  left_join(
    lgd_meta,
    by = c("lgd_code" = "lgd", "lgd_name")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    fr_lgd,
    by = c("lgd_code" = "lgd", "lgd_name")
  )

#3d plot
library(plotly)

plot_ly(
  data = plot_lgd_master,
  x = ~lgd_population,
  y = ~lgd_area_km2,
  z = ~mean_qalys_gained_per_year,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers+text",
  text = ~lgd_name,
  hovertemplate = paste(
    "<b>%{text}</b><br>",
    "Population: %{x}<br>",
    "Area (km²): %{y:.1f}<br>",
    "Mean QALYs/year: %{z:.2f}<extra></extra>"
  ),
  marker = list(size = 5)
) %>%
  layout(
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "Population"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Area (km²)"),
      zaxis = list(title = "Mean QALYs gained per year")
    ),
    title = "Population, area, and QALYs gained by LGD under lambda_across_NI"
  )
```

```{r}
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(nudge_y = 0.4, size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "LGD population",

    title = "Population and QALYs gained by LGD"
  ) +

  labs(

  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
    mean_survivor_cost_per_year = mean(sim_survivor_cost_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_scheme_cost_per_year = mean(sim_scheme_cost_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_total_cost_per_year = mean(sim_total_cost_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_icer = mean(sim_icer, na.rm = TRUE),
    icer_from_means = mean(sim_total_cost_year, na.rm = TRUE) /
      mean(sim_qalys_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_arrests_per_year = mean(n_arrests, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ambulance_time = mean(avg_ambulance_time, na.rm = TRUE),

#Getting FR count for the lambda rule again

rule_to_plot <- "lambda_across_NI"

fr_lgd <- fr_alloc_all_rules %>%
  filter(rule == rule_to_plot) %>%
   group_by(rule, lgd, lgd_name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_fr_lgd = sum(fr_target, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Build LGD master plotting table
plot_lgd_master_maps <- ni_lambda_lgd %>%
  left_join(
    lgd_meta,
    by = c("lgd_code" = "lgd", "lgd_name")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    fr_lgd,
    by = c("lgd_code" = "lgd", "lgd_name")
  )

map1_sf <- lgd_sf %>%
  left_join(
    plot_lgd_master_maps %>% select(lgd_code, lgd_name, total_fr_lgd),
    by = c("lgd" = "lgd_code", "lgd_name")
  )

ggplot(map1_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = total_fr_lgd), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "FRs") +
  labs(
    title = "Number of first responders by LGD"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

map2_sf <- lgd_sf %>%
  left_join(
    plot_lgd_master %>% select(lgd_code, lgd_name, mean_qalys_gained_per_year),
    by = c("lgd" = "lgd_code", "lgd_name")
  )

ggplot(map2_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = mean_qalys_gained_per_year), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Mean QALYs/year") +

    subtitle = "Rule: Random across NI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()



map3_sf <- lgd_sf %>%
  left_join(
    plot_lgd_master %>% select(lgd_code, lgd_name, icer_from_means),
    by = c("lgd" = "lgd_code", "lgd_name")
  )

ggplot(map3_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = pmin(icer_from_means, 50000)), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "ICER (£/QALY)",
    labels = scales::label_dollar(prefix = "£", big.mark = ","),
    na.value = "grey80"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Cost-effectiveness by LGD",
    subtitle = "Rule: Random across NI (capped at £50,000/QALY)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
